Date: 2025-11-08T17:12:00Z
Subject: Latency bakeoff results — readout scheduling and attendees

Hi Ravi,

Thanks again for running the sandbox tests with our Dedicated setup last week. Marissa and I reviewed the raw traces and have a concise set of slides that explain the trade-offs we saw across sequence lengths, batching, and KV cache behavior. We'd like to do a 60-minute readout with your engineering + procurement/security folks so we can: 

- Walk through the benchmark results (tail and p50/p95): what drove the variance
- Discuss configuration/quantization trade-offs that hit your latency SLOs
- Agree on next steps: pilot sizing and procurement timeline

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 2025-11-11 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thu 2025-11-13 09:00–10:00 PT
- Fri 2025-11-14 13:00–14:00 PT

Attached: redwood-readout-agenda.pdf (agenda + required pre-reads). We anticipate inviting one member each from your engineering, security, and procurement teams. Please let me know which slot works and who should be on the invite.

Thanks,
--
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

We hear procurement's request — we'll add a 10-minute block at the end for contract/timing expectations (high level). To accommodate afternoon preference, how about these updated slots (PT):

- Mon 2025-11-17 11:00–12:00 PT

- Alex (security) will have two questions about data retention and audit logs — if Mina can be ready with a short summary that would be great.

We'll confirm final attendee list tomorrow; for now plan for Alex + myself + Ravi. I can also take the DocuSign review offline after the call.
